activity_summary: The morning's work was where to wait. Bryan put you in a passage and then a plain room, and forbade a busy wandering. Burbage told you that you go in first, on the line you have, in the paper crown and the old velvet, and not yet. Sam brought yesterday's about ten up against the house's nine, after supper, when the chair is not empty. You refused to mend either hour. Nick was there and did not sing. A whisper in that hall is a speech. You were not to begin one with a yeoman.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused to mend the two hours, and kept the first entrance unadorned.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Set the place of waiting, the hour of nine, and the bow.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Named the first entrance and the size of a whisper.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Asked which hour is true, and which bow to spend.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Stood against the wall and did not sing.

facets.activity: Refused to change Sam's about ten or the house's nine

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: The house has nine, after supper. At nine the chair is not empty.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I told him about ten, yesterday, because about ten was the answer I had. Nine is the house.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Thou goest in first, when it is time. The line is the line thou hast.
